items.name: Rosca Estrita na Parede (Strict Curl - costas e glúteos colados na parede)
items.movement: Strict wall barbell curl: back AND buttocks remain against vertical wall, feet slightly forward, elbows fixed at ribs. Supinated barbell moves thighs to chest via elbow flexion only.

items.name: Rosca Inversa na Polia Baixa
items.movement: Standing LOW CABLE REVERSE curl: BOTH hands overhand PRONATED grip on straight bar, palms DOWN, elbows at ribs, curl thighs to lower chest then extend.

items.name: Rosca Inversa com Halteres
items.movement: Standing dumbbell REVERSE curl: two dumbbells PRONATED palms down throughout, elbows fixed ribs, flex elbows lifting weights toward lower chest then lower.

items.name: Flexão de Punho Sentado com Halteres
items.movement: Seated dumbbell WRIST flexion: forearms supported on thighs PALMS UP, wrists beyond knees, fingers hold dumbbells; ONLY wrists bend from extended down to flexed up. Elbows and forearms fixed. Medium view shows hands clearly and full seated athlete.

items.name: Extensão de Punho Sentado com Barra (Palma para baixo)
items.movement: Seated barbell WRIST extension: forearms on thighs PALMS DOWN overhand grip, wrists beyond knees. ONLY wrists extend bar upward then return, no elbow curl.

items.name: Extensão de Punho na Polia Baixa
items.movement: Seated cable WRIST extension: forearms on bench PALMS DOWN, wrists beyond edge, straight bar connected LOW pulley front, ONLY wrist extension lifts bar then lower. Elbows/forearms stay flat.

items.name: Fechamento de Gripper (Hand Grip / Capitains of Crush)
items.movement: Hand gripper closure: seated athlete right elbow supported thigh, holds spring hand gripper with two metal handles in right hand. OPEN handles at start, squeeze fingers to close handles together, release. Macro hand-focused camera including forearm, same gripper and hand position.

items.name: Tríceps Testa com Barra Reta
items.movement: Flat bench straight-bar skullcrusher: supine feet floor, both upper arms vertical fixed over shoulders, bar straight over chest. Bend elbows bar toward forehead then extend to vertical. Elbows fixed, no bench press.

items.name: Tríceps Testa no Banco Inclinado com Barra W
items.movement: Incline45degree bench EZ-bar skullcrusher: supine back/head supported, upper arms angled slightly behind vertical fixed, bend elbows EZ bar toward upper forehead then extend. Feet fixed floor.

items.name: Tríceps Testa no Banco Declinado com Barra W
items.movement: DECLINE20degree bench EZ-bar skullcrusher: athlete head LOWER than hips, ankles held bench rollers, upper arms vertical fixed. Bend elbows EZbar toward forehead then extend. Full apparatus visible.

items.name: Supino Pegada Fechada no Smith
items.movement: Smith CLOSE-GRIP bench press: supine on flat bench under Smith bar on TWO vertical rails, hands shoulder-width close grip. Lower bar to lower chest with elbows tucked then press straight up. Feet floor torso fixed.

items.name: Tríceps Francês na Polia Alta com Corda (Inclinado à frente, de costas para o aparelho)
items.movement: Overhead rope cable triceps extension: athlete FACES AWAY from HIGH pulley behind, torso leans forward30degrees, split stance. Upper arms next to ears fixed pointing forward, bend elbows hands behind head then extend arms forward overhead, rope cable over shoulders.

items.name: Tríceps Pulley Unilateral (Pegada Pronada, Supinada ou Neutra sem puxador)
items.movement: Unilateral cable triceps pushdown: standing facing HIGH pulley, right hand grasps cable end directly with NO handle attachment, elbow pinned ribs. Start elbow90degrees, extend elbow hand to hip then return. Left arm relaxed.

items.name: Tríceps Coice Bilateral no Banco Inclinado com Halteres
items.movement: Prone INCLINE bench bilateral dumbbell triceps kickback: chest supported30degree bench, upper arms beside torso pointing behind fixed, elbows initially90degree, extend BOTH elbows to straight arms behind, then bend. No shoulder swing.

items.name: Extensão de Tríceps com Elástico (Band Pushdown)
items.movement: Resistance BAND triceps pushdown: elastic band anchored overhead to fixed bar, BOTH hands hold band ends, elbows pinned ribs. Elbows90degree then extend hands toward thighs stretching band then return. Band visibly stretches, not cable machine.

items.name: Elevação de Panturrilha em Pé com Barra Livre
items.movement: Standing FREE BARBELL calf raise: barbell upper back, both forefeet on LOW stable step, heels hanging. Knees straight, raise both heels onto toes then lower heels below step edge. Fixed bar and stance.

items.name: Panturrilha em Pé com Pés Abduzidos (Pontas para fora - ênfase na cabeça medial)
items.movement: Standing calf raise TOES OUT: feet externally rotated modest30degrees, forefeet on low step heels hanging, hands on support. Knees straight; rise onto forefeet then lower heels. Toe orientation stays turned OUT throughout.

items.name: Panturrilha em Pé com Pés Aduzidos (Pontas para dentro - ênfase na cabeça lateral)
items.movement: Standing calf raise TOES IN: feet internally rotated modest15degrees, forefeet on low step heels hanging, hands on support. Knees straight; rise onto forefeet then lower heels. Toe orientation stays turned IN throughout.

items.name: Abdominal Supra com Peso no Peito (Anilha ou Halter)
items.movement: Weighted abdominal CRUNCH: supine mat knees bent feet flat, hold small weight plate against CHEST with both hands. Lift only shoulder blades upper back via trunk flexion, lower back remains floor, then lower. No sit-up.

items.name: Abdominal na Bola Suíça (Swiss Ball Crunch - Maior amplitude de extensão)
items.movement: Swiss ball abdominal crunch: lower back supported on stable Swiss ball, feet wide flat on floor, knees90degrees, hands crossed chest. Start torso gently extended over ball, curl upper torso lifting shoulder blades through spinal flexion, return. Hips stay ball, feet fixed. Side view entirebody ball20%margin.

items.name: Abdominal Remador
items.movement: V-UP TUCK / rowing abdominal crunch: supine on mat arms extended overhead legs straight hovering; simultaneously flex torso and bend knees bringing knees toward chest and arms reaching forward beside shins, then extend back to long position. Side view fullbody all limbs20%margin, fixed pelvis/mat/camera.

items.name: Giro Russo Sentado com Peso ou Medicine Ball (Russian Twist)
items.movement: Seated Russian twist with medicine ball: seated floor knees bent feet planted, torso leans back30degrees. Both hands hold ball in front chest, rotate torso/ball left then center then right then center in6sequential phases. Pelvis/feet fixed.

items.name: Flexão Lateral de Tronco em Pé com Halter ou na Polia (Side Bend)
items.movement: Standing single-dumbbell side bend: ONE dumbbell in RIGHT hand hanging at side, left hand at waist, knees straight soft. Laterally bend torso right sliding dumbbell down right thigh then return upright. No forward bend or twist.

items.name: Superman no Solo (Extensão lombar deitado de bruços)
items.movement: Prone SUPERMAN on mat: sports mannequin in gray fitted T-shirt shorts shoes lies face DOWN arms extended FORWARD overhead legs straight. Raise BOTH arms and BOTH legs slightly off floor simultaneously with chest slightly lifted, then lower. Small controlled amplitude neutral neck. Side view full body all limbs with20%margin.
